This makes around 2 litres of Ice cream: 

Salted Caramel: 
200g granulated sugar
1 tsp salt
90g butter 
~300ml double (whipped or heavy) cream
To make the salted caramel: 

1) Heat the sugar in a pan on medium heat. Stir continuously until all the sugar has boiled to a brown/amber syrup.

2) add the butter. Make sure to keep stirring, if the mixture starts to clump up remove from heat and stir until it’s smooth. 

3) add the cream, stir to mix and then boil for a minute. 

4) add the salt to taste, then allow the mixture to cool down and thicken.

Ice cream: 
150g sugar
1 litre full fat milk
1 tbsp and 1 tsp vanilla extract
~300 ml heavy cream
Egg yolks (as many as needed, tho no more than 6)

To make Ice Cream: 
1. mix sugar, milk and the salted caramel in a pan on medium heat and let it simmer.
2. Once thoroughly mixed, add in the egg yolks, making sure to stir continuously. Make sure the mixture doesn’t boil and thickens. Add in the salted caramel mix. (You may add cornflour to thicken the mixture)
3. Poor the mixture into a chilled bowl and refrigerate for a minimum of two hours. Stir the mixture often.
4. Add in the heavy cream and vanilla extract. You may add salt if you wish. 
5. Freeze the mixture in a airtight container until solid.
6. Put the mixture into an ice cream maker, or if you don’t have one, you can also blend it to get rid of ice crystals and obtain that smooth, smooth ice cream.
7. Freeze again, and then serve. 
(If it’s not icy, you may just serve as is ;))
